lines: A new face in my studio! Mind the hay.
It was a barn, darling. The cows were terrible dancers.
Chin up and point those toes!
String lights? Try the street round the green, darling.

rotate: And one, and two, and spin! Lovely!
Friday is disco. Monday is ballet. I like Fridays.
Even the mayor dances at my recital. Badly.
Dancing is walking with more joy in it.
